comment: Frozen task set for WO-20260728-reconstruction-bench. Committed and hashed before the first scored run (risk R7 of the design). Atoms are matched after the shared normalizer (JSON-unescape, strip * and `, strip digit-group commas, unify dashes, collapse whitespace, casefold). An atom entry is a literal string (must appear) or a list (any-of: one member must appear). 'window': all matched atom positions must fall within this many normalized characters of each other; null = no proximity constraint. 'arm_a': how the reconstruction arm assembles context for this task. 'wake_expected': whether the grade-0 wake payload carries the fact (a design-time prediction the run checks, not a scoring input). 'truth_date': the date of the banked fact, for truth_age_days (risk R1).
